observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly wrapped in clear plastic.
The headlight has a black housing with a yellow or amber section at the top.
The lens is clear and appears intact, but the plastic wrap is crumpled and shows signs of wear.
There is a watermark 'HONDA AND ACURA POSTED ON JIJI' across the image.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlight itself.
The item is photographed on a rough, possibly concrete or stone surface.

claims.claim: Body, engine n suspension parts for all model of honda, acura n toyota cars n suvs
claims.evidence: The photo shows only a headlight assembly, not the full body, engine, or suspension parts. The claim is too broad and cannot be verified from the image.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlight may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken internal components).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens and internal components, showing no cracks or damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged

risks.risk: The headlight may not fit the intended vehicle model (e.g., wrong size, shape, or mounting points).
risks.proof: A photo showing the back of the headlight with mounting points, or a comparison with a known compatible model.

risks.risk: The item may be a counterfeit or non-original part.
risks.proof: A photo of the part's serial number or a close-up of any branding or markings that could indicate authenticity.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the back of the headlight showing mounting points and any part numbers.
Photo of the front of the headlight showing the lens and internal components for damage check.
Photo of the part's serial number or any branding if available.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
